from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollment(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted from a single document for one university."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period or date of the data (e.g., 'Fall 2021')")
    white_non_hispanic_count: int | None = Field(description="Count of undergraduate White, non-Hispanic students")
    nonresident_aliens_count: int | None = Field(description="Count of undergraduate Nonresident alien students")
    hispanic_latino_count: int | None = Field(description="Count of undergraduate Hispanic/Latino students")
    black_african_american_count: int | None = Field(description="Count of undergraduate Black or African American students")
    asian_non_hispanic_count: int | None = Field(description="Count of undergraduate Asian, non-Hispanic students")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityEnrollment]
